description: This file provides functions for managing Tailscale binaries, retrieving status and hostname info, ensuring dependencies, and controlling Tailscale features like funnel and serve, with internal caching and error handling.

methods.name: parsePossiblyNoisyJsonObject
methods.description: Parses JSON from stdout, trimming noise outside JSON object boundaries.

methods.name: findTailscaleBinary
methods.description: Locates the Tailscale binary using multiple strategies: PATH, known macOS path, find, locate.

methods.name: getTailnetHostname
methods.description: Retrieves the Tailscale hostname or IP from the status JSON.

methods.name: getTestTailscaleBinaryOverride
methods.description: Checks environment override for test binary.

methods.name: getTailscaleBinary
methods.description: Returns the path to the Tailscale binary, using cache or detection.

methods.name: readTailscaleStatusJson
methods.description: Reads the Tailscale status in JSON format.

methods.name: ensureGoInstalled
methods.description: Ensures the Go toolchain is installed, offering to install via Homebrew if missing.

methods.name: ensureTailscaledInstalled
methods.description: Ensures tailscaled is installed, offering to install via Homebrew if missing.

methods.name: readTailscaleWhoisIdentity
methods.description: Retrieves and caches the Tailscale Whois identity for an IP.

methods.name: ensureFunnel
methods.description: Enables Tailscale Funnel on a specified port, with setup if not enabled.

methods.name: enableTailscaleServe
methods.description: Enables Tailscale serve on a specified port.

methods.name: enableTailscaleFunnel
methods.description: Enables Tailscale funnel on a specified port.
